==Description==
'''Halloween''' is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]] that adds pumpkins as hats onto every enemy.

'''Halloween''' is active on all maps on the 31st of October to celebrate Halloween. It was first enabled on all maps on the 31st of October 2022 until 1st of November 2022.

==Effects==
When active, the '''Halloween''' modifier will add pumpkins onto every enemy's head to act as a hat.

On some enemies like the [[Normal]], the pumpkin may be much bigger than it should be.

===Enemy Appearance===
''This does not include every enemy in the game, but only some to show the effects of the modifier.''
